title: Overnight Bacterial Cultures
author: Raven Coffer
materials: Return agar plates to the proper storage location.

steps.title: Prepare Workspace
steps.instruction: Clean the work area and prepare the sterile environment.

substeps.instruction: Wipe benches and pipettes with DNAaway and RNase Aaway, then wipe again with 70% ethanol.
Light the bunsen burner and perform all subsequent work close to the flame.

steps.title: Label Culture Tubes
steps.instruction: Label culture tubes with the construct name (or nickname), initials, and date.

substeps.instruction: If using nicknames, create a table in the ELN detailing the designated nickname for each construct (e.g., Nickname: KZK10_A Full name: DHY213_KZK10_02302030_A).

steps.title: Prepare Culture Media
steps.instruction: Prepare the antibiotic-supplemented media in an erlenmeyer flask.

substeps.instruction: Add the desired amount of culture media to the erlenmeyer flask using the formula: (5 mL * x) + 2 mL = total culture media required, where x is the number of cultures.
Add antibiotic to the media at a 1:1000 ratio (e.g., 17 µL of ampicillin for 17 mL of media).
Swirl the flask for approximately 10 seconds to fully mix.

steps.title: Aliquot Media
steps.instruction: Distribute the media into the labeled tubes.

substeps.instruction: Using a serological pipette, aliquot 5 mL of culture media + antibiotic into each labeled culture tube.
Wipe benches and pipettes with DNAaway and RNase Aaway, then wipe with 70% ethanol.

steps.title: Inoculate Cultures
steps.instruction: Inoculate the tubes using either a glycerol stock or a colony from a plate.

substeps.instruction: For glycerol stocks: Obtain stock from -80 °C storage on DRY ICE. Use an inoculation loop to gently scrape the top of the frozen stock. Once a small amount of opaque liquid is observed on the tip, dip into the corresponding culture tube and swirl for 10 seconds. Minimize exposure by closing the lid when not in use and keeping the stock on DRY ICE.
For plate colonies: Use a loop to gently scrape a single white colony from the plate, ensuring not to dig into the solid agar. Dip into the corresponding culture tube and swirl for 10 seconds.
For both methods: Only touch the top third (furthest from the tip) of the inoculation loop to prevent contamination. Discard the loop into the sharps container after each sample.
Immediately return glycerol stocks to storage at -80 °C.

steps.title: Incubate Cultures
steps.instruction: Set up the cultures for growth in the incubator.

substeps.instruction: Place the culture tubes in the incubator tube rack at the appropriate temperature for the sample.
Ensure the lids are moveable (not locked down) to allow air flow into the tubes.
Incubate for the recommended duration at the appropriate shaking speed for the sample.
Rinse the erlenmeyer flask with water in the sink and hang on the drying rack to be washed.
Wipe benches and pipettes with DNAaway and RNase Aaway, then wipe with 70% ethanol.
